questions: Identify actual SaaS supplier, establishment, branch and taxpayer residence/registration.
Classify actual customers and transactions, including resident/non-resident and B2B/B2C where relevant.
Review approved catalogue amounts and manual InstaPay route separately from tax inclusion, rates, tax points and official document obligations.
Identify each actual practice supplier/taxpayer and whether Doctor is software supplier, agent, collector or another role under an approved agreement.
Review each actual service and customer category independently; neither a doctor profile nor a medical label establishes an exemption or obligation.
Determine legally valid collection, refund, cancellation and correction documents for each relevant taxpayer without combining practice money with SaaS subscription settlement.
Require a reviewer-selected interface/document type/version and exact effective scope, rather than assuming latest technical documentation is applicable.
Verify taxpayer and branch identity, official enrollment and separated test/production access before approving any adapter work.
Specify credential/eSeal custody, rotation, revocation, authorized operator and incident handling through private reviewed references; store no secrets in this packet.
Approve exact schema, service/coding/tax treatment, required parties, currency/precision/rounding, document identity and source-linked return/correction rules.
Define uncertain submission/status reconciliation before resending, official acceptance/rejection mapping, audit retention and privacy minimization.

public_document_sources.title: Egyptian eInvoicing & eReceipt SDK — Getting started
public_document_sources.verified_public_observation: Separates taxpayer enrollment, ERP/POS registration, API access credentials and eSeal prerequisites; these are not evidence Doctor is enrolled or subject to a particular obligation.

public_document_sources.title: Common API
public_document_sources.verified_public_observation: Publishes login and document type/version discovery interfaces. No account access or active document version for a Doctor taxpayer was established.

public_document_sources.title: eInvoicing APIs
public_document_sources.verified_public_observation: Separate invoice lifecycle interfaces are documented; no taxpayer-specific applicability or successful official test is established.

public_document_sources.title: eReceipt API
public_document_sources.verified_public_observation: Documents POS authentication, receipt submissions, details, status and notifications. A synthetic application receipt is not an official ETA document.

public_document_sources.title: ETA digital and remote services guidance
public_document_sources.verified_public_observation: Links official non-resident digital/remote-services guidance and Ministerial Decision160/2023. Exact residence, entity, customers and services require accountable current review; no rate, exemption, registration threshold or obligation is selected.

public_sources_limit: Public documentation is reference material, not qualified taxpayer applicability, an approved profile, enrollment/access, custody/signing authority or official test acceptance. No rate, exemption, registration threshold or invoice/receipt obligation is inferred.
